_readme: S697 (worker piles2), Glendale's reconcile_steps lever (33). The 2026-2027 Coursedog completion-requirements pages of the filed records whose blocks sum unequal to the printed total and whose notes say the page's own figures disagree or print a repeat: Addiction Studies Counseling 02570 (AD ST 50 printed '2 x 1'), Fitness Specialist 12574 and 39905 (18-23 against 21-26), Marketing II 19566 (18 against 15), Tax Preparer 12570 (19 against 20), and French Language 36711 (the list a student takes only 'If 20 units have not been reached'). No model call.
